text:
```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]

permissions:
  issues: write
  contents: read

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Run Claude Triage
        uses: anthropics/claude-code-action@beta
        with:
          anthropic_api_key: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          model: claude-sonnet-4-20250514
          prompt: |
            You are an expert triage assistant for the OB1 project (NateBJones-Projects/OB1).
            A new issue has been opened. Your task is to:
            1. Analyze the issue content.
            2. Classify it (e.g., bug, recipe idea, schema idea, extension, documentation).
            3. Check if it seems like a duplicate of common existing issues (based on general knowledge of this repo's scope).
            4. Assess if it fits the scope of OB1 (remote MCP, RLS, JSONB metadata, env vars for creds).
            5. Suggest appropriate labels.
            6. Post a welcoming comment summarizing your triage, suggested labels, and any next steps.

            Issue Title: ${{ github.event.issue.title }}
            Issue Body: ${{ github.event.issue.body }}
            Issue Author: ${{ github.event.issue.user.login }}

            Please format your response as a comment to be posted on the issue.
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
```
